shrinkage_strength_protocol.note: The empirical-Bayes shrinkage strength is estimated ONLY from the training interventions listed here. Every ranker still fits and projects all interventions; only the hyperparameter is restricted. Fixed-strength rankers (shrinkage_0 ... shrinkage_1) estimate nothing and are unaffected.

P1_beats_plain.criterion: both pooled estimators beat plain projection by >= 10% relative

P2_beats_single_scale.criterion: refuted if a pooled estimator's CI lower bound falls below single-scale's point estimate
P2_beats_single_scale.note: predicted at 70% confidence in the pre-registration

P4_lever_arm_interaction.criterion: rho_L >= 2.0; FAILED only if point < 2.0 and CI upper < 2.0

P5_removed_error_type.criterion: fit-error share of removed flips >= 80%, evaluable only at >= 8 removed

verdicts.mechanism_note: compound refutation requires P1 REFUTED and P4 FAILED (UNDERPOWERED does not count)
